request.description:
Starts sign-in for borrowers, CAs, DSAs and lender users. Send exactly one of `mobile` (with optional `countryCode`) or `email`.

`loginAs` is `borrower | ca | dsa | lender` (default `borrower`) and decides which membership the session opens with. Optional `referralCode` (4-24 letters, numbers or hyphens) is stored on the user at signup.

Email codes are only delivered to emails already linked to an account or holding a pending invitation; the response is identical either way.

Limits: 30-second resend cooldown, 5 codes per identifier per hour, 30 requests per IP per hour.
